entities.summary: Shaheer Nawaz Sheikh is an Indian actor who predominantly works in Hindi television. Considered as one of the highest paid television actors in India, Sheikh is a recipient of several accolades including an ITA Award, an Indian Telly Award and two Gold Awards.
